title: Apple iPhone XS, XS Max, and iPhone XR RAM size confirmed in benchmark test
text: Apple iPhone XS, XS Max, and iPhone XR RAM size confirmed in benchmark test Friday, 14 September 2018 ( 16 hours ago ) Apple announced its 2018 iPhone line-up at an event in Cupertino, California on Wednesday, and as ever didn’t reveal the amount of RAM it included in the new iPhone XS , iPhone XS Max , and iPhone XR The key highlights of these new iPhones is that all of them feature Apple’s latest A12 Bionic chipset that […] Following the announcement of the iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max, iPhone XR and the Apple Watch Series 4, CNET editors have their say.
